title: K Inverse Pairs Array
summary: Given integers n and k, find the count of distinct arrays made from numbers 1 to n with exactly k inverse pairs.
statement: Given integers n and k, find the count of distinct arrays made from numbers 1 to n with exactly k inverse pairs. Return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Count permutations of 1 through n with exactly k inverse pairs; return the result modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Inserting the new largest value adds from zero through size minus one inversions.
Use dynamic programming and a sliding prefix sum over the previous row.
For each size and k, sum the previous counts from k-size+1 through k.
The direct transition is correct but cubic; prefix differences reduce every range sum to constant time.
editorial: The direct transition is correct but cubic; prefix differences reduce every range sum to constant time.

tests.explanation: The permutations [1,3,2] and [2,1,3] each have one inverse pair.
